title: The Small Postcards
author: M. M. Blackwood
blurb: Ivo Nystrom, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
